messages.subject: geom_jitter
parts:
I noticed when I plot values that are zero in value the points as jitter still appear event though the box is not even displayed.  Do I need to change something in my code:(position = position_jitter(width=0.1)

I guess the function above jitters vertical as well? I thought it was height...please advise the full code I am using is below. 

Thank you.



ggplot(my.table, aes(x=State, y=Value, fill=State)
+ geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)
+ scale_fill_manual(values=c("dodgerblue", "pink1"))
+ geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width=0.1), color="black", size=3, alpha=0.3)

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: geom_jitter
parts:
Jitter works in horizontal and vertical way. You are currently jittering horizontally (width). You can so do vertically (`height`), but if you have values on y, this may not be correct.

Cheers,
Roman
